verdict.rationale: ReadMe explicitly supports uploading/transforming an OpenAPI spec into interactive API reference docs (readme-docs-23) and interactive try-it-out console (readme-docs-1). Ongoing sync is supported via the rdme CLI and bi-directional GitHub/GitLab sync features (readme-docs-26, readme-probe-3, readme-probe-rt-3), which can be used to keep specs and docs updated automatically in CI. Missing for 10: explicit documentation/example of automatic re-generation triggered specifically by OpenAPI spec changes (e.g. webhook-based spec sync) and independent hands-on confirmation that reference pages update live when the spec changes.
